主要内容: On January 8, 2018, Insperity, Inc. announced that its President, Richard G. Rawson, would retire effective May 18, 2018. Mr. Rawson will continue to serve as a member of the Company’s board of directors. The Company also announced that James D. Allison will become the Company’s Senior Vice President of Gross Profit Operations effective May 18, 2018. Mr. Allison, age 49, has served as the Company’s Senior Vice President of Pricing & Cost Analysis since 2011. The changes reflect internal leadership transitions within the company's management structure, impacting its operational and strategic direction.
